amendment_reason: Nearest-work Round C found DARC diagnosis-guided recovery-interface admission plus Sovereign Assurance Boundary / Sovereign Execution Broker certificate-bound mutation admission and enforcement. These absorb generic 'diagnosis chooses a permitted recovery action', proposal-vs-authority separation, evidence-bound mutation certificates, scoped execution capability, and broker enforcement. DAML additionally removes generic context-sensitive action permission as novelty. These findings narrow the claim boundary but do not require a new behavioral arm beyond the already-frozen strongest operational R2Act+dependency-rollback parent: SAB/SEB enforce an externally supplied policy, while R3 tests the scientific policy content itself. No confirmatory holdout exists and no decision margin changes.
